name: UHI: Continuous Morphology Archetypes for Heat Mitigation Across Cities
description: Reproducible pipeline and harmonised open dataset relating continuous urban morphology to summer surface urban heat island intensity across 66 cities and 15 Köppen climate zones, using Landsat 8/9 land-surface temperature and open global building-footprint-with-height products. Implements ingest, feature extraction, linear mixed-effects and XGBoost+SHAP attribution, empirical Pareto extraction and morphology archetype clustering.
